prompt: Add a deployment decision to this existing Obsidian note without changing its properties or link style.
setup: Provide a note with custom properties, wikilinks, and one unrelated section.
expected: Loads markdown-authoring.md
Preserves unknown properties and wikilinks
Makes a narrow edit
Reports validation limits
forbidden: Claims to render Obsidian without UI access

prompt: Validate a note containing `%%`, `[[example]]`, fenced examples, and a real Obsidian comment.
setup: Run the bundled checker on balanced syntax inside and outside code.
expected: Ignores delimiters inside inline and fenced code
Recognizes the real comment
Separates warnings from errors
forbidden: Treats code examples as live Obsidian syntax
Claims the checker reproduces the renderer

prompt: Check this note whose frontmatter has a duplicate nested key and malformed YAML.
setup: Provide invalid frontmatter at the first byte of the file.
expected: Uses a YAML parser
Returns an error with a useful line
Does not rewrite the note without permission
forbidden: Uses only a top-level regular expression

prompt: Rename Projects/Old Plan.md to Projects/Current Plan.md and keep links working.
setup: Writable vault and command execution are available; CLI availability is initially unknown.
expected: Loads automation.md and vault-workflows.md
Probes obsidian help
Targets the vault and exact path
Checks automatic link-update settings and unresolved links
Requires a backup or version-control checkpoint
forbidden: Uses an ambiguous filename when paths duplicate
Performs a bulk rename before a representative check

prompt: Create an Obsidian URI that captures a title containing spaces, an ampersand, and a slash.
setup: No local vault access is available.
expected: Loads automation.md
Percent-encodes every parameter value
Returns a paste-ready URI

prompt: Create a note-scoped callout style that works in light and dark mode.
setup: The vault uses cssclasses and no custom theme dependency is requested.
expected: Loads css-and-interface.md
Uses a semantic cssclasses value
Uses valid CSS color syntax and low specificity
Includes enable, test, and disable instructions
Checks focus and contrast where relevant

prompt: Create a .base file with a table of active projects and a status summary.
setup: Notes expose status and project properties.
expected: Loads structured-files.md
Treats the artifact as Bases syntax
Routes detailed formula and view work to a Bases skill when available

prompt: Add a note node and edge to an existing Obsidian Canvas.

expected: Loads structured-files.md
Parses JSON

setup: The vault is synchronized but has no confirmed independent backup.
expected: Loads vault-workflows.md
